title: 1994 Air Force holographic projector concept

tellings.quote: In 1999, reporter William Arkin wrote an article about a 1994 Air Force concept for a holographic projector,

plain: A podcast host, Jesse Michels, says that in 1999 a reporter named William Arkin wrote about a 1994 US Air Force idea for a holographic projector, a device that could cast realistic images into the sky. Michels raises it because, if such a tool existed, some UFO sightings could be the military's own staged illusions.
